params.name: q
params.description:
Returns the content items for the search term (q).

Example: q=Gotthardtunnel

params.name: edges
params.description:
Should the edges/relations to dossiers, routes and pois also be returned (default: true)?

Example: edges=false

items.docs: Returns content items (e-rara, emaps, E-Pics, e-periodica etc) of pois defined in the ETHorama database. The content items are resources of the eth library that are associated with the POI and describe it.
